phases.message: I'm Marit, Tarnbrook Outfitters. First, in the Markwick filing desk, read the rules and every registration on our docket, in full. Don't file anything yet: I'll send you to the store, our papers and my mail next.
This is our store. Read every product: what we still sell, when we last sold it, and the photographs we have of each.
These are our papers. Read all of them.
This is my mail. Read every message.

Back at the filing desk. For each registration that has to be maintained now, file the declaration the rules require, with a specimen for every class, only the goods we still sell, and the fee for it. Leave alone what is not due, what is already done, what is no longer ours, and what cannot be declared. Then tell me what you filed, the fees, and what you left alone and why.

rules.text: Markwick filing desk: the rules of keeping a registration alive. Friday 9 October 2026. Topics: windows, declaration, specimens, fees, nonuse, owner. Count from the registration date: the 5th, 6th and 10th anniversaries are that date in the later year.

Friday 9 October 2026. Section 8 (15 U.S.C. 1058; 37 CFR 2.160): a declaration of use is due between the 5th and 6th anniversary of the registration, and then in the year before the end of every 10-year period: between the 9th and 10th anniversary, the 19th and 20th, and so on. A section 8 and section 9 renewal (15 U.S.C. 1059) are filed together at each 10-year point. A 6-month grace period follows each deadline, with a surcharge for each class. After the grace period ends the registration is cancelled or expires and cannot be revived: a new application is the only way.

Friday 9 October 2026. A section 8 declaration (37 CFR 2.161) is made by the owner, who must be the owner of record on the day. It gives the registration number, lists the goods in each class that are in use in commerce, deletes the goods that are not, gives one specimen for each class showing the mark in use now, and pays the fee for each class. Filing for fewer goods than the registration lists means naming the goods deleted.

Friday 9 October 2026. A specimen (37 CFR 2.56) shows the mark as actually used in commerce: for goods, on the goods, their container or packaging, a label or tag, or a point-of-sale display, or a web page that shows the goods with the mark, a price and a means of ordering. A computer illustration, digital image or similar mock-up of how the mark may be displayed is not a specimen. One specimen is needed for each class.

Friday 9 October 2026. USPTO fees for filing electronically, for each class (37 CFR 2.6(a)): section 8 declaration 325 dollars; section 9 renewal 325 dollars; section 8 filed in the grace period, a surcharge of 100 dollars; renewal filed in the grace period, a surcharge of 100 dollars; deleting goods or a class after a section 8 is submitted and before it is accepted, 250 dollars a class. Goods deleted inside the filing itself cost nothing extra.

Friday 9 October 2026. A section 8 may claim excusable nonuse for goods not in use only by showing special circumstances that excuse the nonuse and no intent to abandon (37 CFR 2.161(a)(6)). The owner's own decision to stop making or selling a good is not such a circumstance, so goods no longer sold are deleted, never declared in use. Declaring use for a good that is not in use is a false statement under oath.

Friday 9 October 2026. Only the owner of record may file. A registration assigned to someone else is theirs to maintain, whatever this docket still lists. Filing fees are paid by the filer and are not refunded.

docs.title: Assignment of TARNBROOK SPORTS
docs.text: Assignment dated 2 May 2024: Tarnbrook Outfitters LLC assigns the mark TARNBROOK SPORTS, registration 6361822, with the goodwill of the business it identifies, to Fellmoor Brands Inc. Recorded 2024-05-02.

docs.title: Memo: the glove line ends
docs.text: Memo dated 14 February 2023 from Marit Aldous: the leather glove line ends today. The last pairs sell out by 20 February 2023. No gloves will be made again.

docs.title: Memo: the snowshoe line ends
docs.text: Memo dated 19 March 2024 from Marit Aldous: the snowshoe line ends today after the last pair sold. We do not plan to make snowshoes again.

docs.title: Alpine sleeping bag launch plan
docs.text: Plan dated 22 June 2026: the Alpine sleeping bag has a pre-order page with a render. The first production run ships in spring 2027. No bag has been sold or shipped.

mail.subject: Section 8 accepted: TARNBROOK KIDS, registration 6154803
mail.body: The section 8 declaration filed on 14 May 2026 for registration 6154803 has been accepted. No further maintenance filing is due until the year before the tenth anniversary.

mail.subject: TARNBROOK SPORTS reminders
mail.body: We have owned TARNBROOK SPORTS, registration 6361822, since the May 2024 assignment. Please stop forwarding its reminders to us as if they were yours.
